The '''Myyydril Caverns''' was a group of [[cave]]rns located on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]].<ref name="BMF 43" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the Myyydril Caverns were introduced in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 43|forty-third]] issue of the [[De Agostini]] ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="BMF 43" /> which was published around [[October 28]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BuildFalconDates|43}}</ref>

The [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|caverns]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where they were introduced in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=location|Myyydril Caverns|Kashyyyk}}</ref>
